subject: Future Tech
title: China's AV Surge
description: Learn China's AV Surge in one minute.

hook.text: While US companies debate regulations, China deployed robotaxis in 10 cities.

buildup.text: China's advantage: government support, simpler regulations, and massive data from dense urban traffic.

discovery.text: Baidu, Pony.ai, WeRide, and AutoX are leading China's AV wave.

twist.text: Chinese AVs use their own mapping, AI, and chips—independent of US technology. A parallel AV ecosystem is forming.

climax.text: China aims to have AVs operating in most major cities by 2030.

punchline.text: Two AV ecosystems, two approaches, one global race.

quiz.question: How many rides does Baidu's Apollo Go complete per quarter?
